_meta.behavior: DATA ONLY. No module reads these rules yet. Building the progression engine is OUT OF SCOPE for this PR.
_meta.purpose: Encodes the deterministic progression decision table so a future ProgressionModule can consume it.

decision_table.when: Hit all planned sets, reached top of rep target, technique acceptable, pain low, effort easier than prescribed
Hit all planned sets with appropriate effort and technique
Missed top of range but stayed within minimum reps and tolerance
Missed minimum reps on multiple sets, effort much harder than prescribed, or velocity suppressed
Local joint pain, compensatory technique, or sharp focal pain emerged
Multiple consecutive exposures underperform expected output despite acceptable recovery

lever_order.description: Cheapest-to-most-expensive progression lever. Increase load before reps before sets; sets are the expensive lever (fatigue + time).

increment_defaults.description: Default load jumps when increasing. Heuristic; smallest available increment wins.
increment_defaults.note: ACSM: 2-10% load increase when the trainee can perform 1-2 reps over target.

one_bad_session_vs_plateau.ignore_single_session_if: isolated and explainable (poor sleep, stress, missed nutrition) with no red flags
one_bad_session_vs_plateau.flag_plateau_if: no progress across >=3 sessions or 2-3 weeks despite adequate recovery
